remarks: For the first time in decades, the meticulously maintained residence at 3 Lycett Court is available. The open-concept layout is brimming with elegant updates, chef's kitchen and dining area. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, minutes from train station, highways, beaches, dining and more. Kick back on the attached deck, ideal for entertaining or sipping morning coffee. This home is sprawling with possibilities, including a cozy fireplace to warm up in winter, flex-bedroom that can serve as a home office, home gym or in-law apt. The yard is equally impressive, featuring a flagstone walkway, perennial gardens and lush landscape. The attached 2 car garage and built-ins have even more storage. Spacious living areas, a state-of-the-art kitchen, Bosch appliances, Sonance whole house sound system, Bain Ultra soaking bathtub, HansGrohe bath fixtures, High speed internet, Honeywell home security system, and more. Make it your home. Visit 3lycett."com"
